name: Proud Tek Engineering Team
shortBio: Collective reviewer byline for product specification pages reviewed jointly by Proud Tek's production-engineering group.
bio: The Proud Tek Engineering Team is the collective reviewer byline used on product specification pages (RFID keyfobs, tags and similar SKU pages) where technical review is performed jointly by the production-engineering group rather than by a single named reviewer. The group's engineering core covers wet-inlay assembly, encoding, anti-metal lamination and reader integration; specification claims on reviewed pages are checked against the vendor datasheet cited in each page's sources block.
